newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said Friday its board of directors approved a two-for-one stock split in the form of a stock dividend.
The stock split is expected to be completed in February, it added.
The company said it will establish a record date for the split shortly.

With regard to the acquisition of California Jockey Club and Bay Meadows Operating Co, two real estate concerns, Patriot American said the exchange ratio for the merger will be adjusted accordingly to give a neutral effect for the split.
Patriot American its a real estate investment trust that acquires, redevelops and repositions hotels.
